Full Stack Developer

We are hiring a Full Stack Developer to build and scale our web platform.

Responsibilities:
- Design and build features with React and Node.js
- Develop REST APIs using Express.js and MongoDB
- Write automated tests with Jest
- Deploy services using Docker and AWS
- Work in an Agile team and review pull requests on GitHub

Requirements:
- 1-3 years of experience with JavaScript and TypeScript
- Strong knowledge of React, Node.js, MongoDB and SQL
- Familiarity with CI/CD, Kubernetes and Redis is a plus
- Good understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms
